limitations: One x86_64 Docker host/kernel, generated clients, no ARM/physical network or real attacks evaluation
Post-fix auth/ACL replacements collected in a later batch; host scheduling/batch confounding remains, same pool/settings/toolchain retained
Disk budgets are monitored, not hard filesystem quotas; same host shared resources remain a limitation
27% unknown excluded fail-closed; 68% exact cross-partition fingerprint purge alters prevalence; narrow validation/test violation support
No empirical proof of absolute clock accuracy, packetwise maliciousness, statistical capture independence or absence of shortcuts
No new trained models, trusted detector changes, live Network IDS or crypto switching
